properties.description: Three test files in crates/reflow2-mcp/tests, written first and run as the workspace suite runs them. (1) a_served_item_is_removed_only_after_a_release_that_announced_it.rs, over the protocol with test-only registry entries: a deprecated tool still works and its description carries the mark; a deprecated argument and reply field are marked; describe_schema marks a deprecated node type, property and edge type; a call that uses a deprecated item gets the notice and one using none gets nothing; a removed tool's old name is refused with what to do; the registry as built leaves tools/list equal to the toolsnap goldens; the registry names only what this build serves. (2) every_deprecation_is_announced_in_the_changelog.rs: the changelog check on the real files, and failing an entry without its fragment. (3) the_mcp_surface_only_grows.rs: a removal passes only when the last release's record marks it deprecated, an unmarked one fails, and the main test compares this build with v0.84.0's record.
properties.findings: Run 2026-10-14 on branch feat/a-served-item-is-removed-only-after-a-release-that-announced-it at afb1e1aed (debug build, this worktree's own target): all 15 new tests pass — 7 in a_served_item_is_removed_only_after_a_release_that_announced_it.rs, 5 in every_deprecation_is_announced_in_the_changelog.rs, 3 in the_mcp_surface_only_grows.rs — plus deprecation.rs's 3 unit tests; CI's workspace job (run 38613643952) ran both crates' suites green on the same commit. WRITTEN FIRST (513f60e3d): on main the registry does not exist, so they do not build; with an inert registry (types only) 11 of 15 failed, each on the missing behaviour, and the 4 that passed are the before-and-after invariants. What the run found: with test-only entries, get_node's reply is unchanged but for `deprecation_notice` and its description opens with "DEPRECATED in 0.99.0, removed in the next release: …"; scan_nodes' `brief` carries the mark and its sibling `limit` does not; describe_schema marks Anchor, Requirement.kind and ANTICIPATES and lists 7 deprecations; the notice fires for the argument passed (not when omitted), the node type named and read back, the property written through add_requirement and read back by scan_nodes, the edge type drawn, the reply field got, and not for add_project; add_anchor is refused "tool not found … DEPRECATED in 0.99.0 … Call add_snapshot instead."; with the registry as built (empty) tools/list equals all 197 toolsnap goldens; the surface check passes each of seven removals only when the record announced it and still fails every unannounced one; the main surface test passes against v0.84.0's record re-blessed from the published binary (sha256 bdc54e7b…f1e1). Also run: toolsnap.py (ALL 197 MATCH), smoke_mcp.py, a_reply_is_sent_once.py, empty_speaks.py, replies_are_bounded.py, skill_lint.py, changelog_fragments.py --check, clippy for both configurations, fmt.
properties.name: A served item is removed only after a release that announced it
